title: The 1966 Copenhagen record
summary: She played piano on "Mighty Tight Woman" on a Copenhagen record, with Little Brother playing on the rest.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: You liked that record, that one that you did in 1966 in Copenhagen. You liked hearing that just now very much.

Yeah. (Unintelligible) from Copenhagen. He said, "Sippie, who is that playing piano for you for --" what was I singing? "Woman Be Wise," I think (unintelligible). And he say, "Who was playing that piano on --" Oh, "Mighty Tight Woman." He said (unintelligible) me, myself and I.
Yeah, I said, me and myself and I.
He said, "I made a lot of sales on there, but you know, not too much sale." He said, "I'm going to send you a little check." He said, "But Sippie, (inaudible)."
He said, "But I'm going to give you something," said, "because I sure did sell -- your record sure did sell with me."
